notes: All PNG layers use the exact 894x839 source canvas.
Visible skull artwork is directly extracted from the original source without resizing or repositioning.
No hair, beard, ponytail or other clear secondary-motion part was split into a separate spring layer.
The static body layer contains the hood, cloak, necklace, crystal pendant and all non-head elements.
A narrow hidden neck/hood area behind the skull was reconstructed only to support subtle head translation and rotation.
eyes_closed.png is a full-canvas transparent blink overlay that replaces the glowing eye sockets with darker closed sockets.
Normalized pivot coordinates use x=0 left, x=1 right, y=0 bottom, y=1 top.
